It was my 1st time making pcb designs.I have never ever used KiCad before.It took me 2 days to learn  cad and I got some confidence and decided to make my own pcb today 1st of all I decided to make just an macro pad with some button with node mcu,but later on I decided to add display making project a bit difficult to me .

### 2026-10-10 – I just completely  re edited my  pcb design after founding many problem .The main problem is that there in my country Xiao esp is very expensive and rare so I switch to Esp32 s3 dev board which is che

**4h**

I just completely  re edited my  pcb design after founding many problem .The main problem is that there in my country Xiao esp is very expensive and rare so I switch to Esp32 s3 dev board which is cheap and easy to found I also decided to remove physical switches and add electrical touch sensor module.

This time the main problem was I was not able to add espresso library to the kicad app and I forgot film it .I may finished it by today if yesterday I was able to add espresso library in ki cad and  my one day just gone for adding library .I don't know  what even  happen after successfully adding library it was not working then I re download the file and it work.

Making the pcb second time was way easier.The most difficult was to route and I am learning it by my self rather watching video in YouTube so I made a big mistake I route my pcb in back side only fist which was very difficult to manage and later on I fount we have to select for the front layer so I re edit my file.I am very excited to fully make my pcb perfect .There are many small tweaks left to do and check the pcb which I will be doing tomorrow or today evening.
